part.text:
Fixed date-only ISO-8601 parsing in `gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/internal/bind/util/ISO8601Utils.java`.

The date-only `GregorianCalendar` is now non-lenient, so impossible values such as `2022-14-30` and `2022-12-33` produce `ParseException` instead of rolling into later valid dates. Existing default-timezone behavior remains unchanged.

Validated with:

```sh
docker exec cli-eval-opencode-google__gson-2134-f4bde17d sh -lc 'cd /testbed && mvn -pl gson -Dtest=ISO8601UtilsTest test'
```

Result: 9 tests run, 0 failures, build successful.
